claim: the filling was done at the producer's own premises, at a co-operative's, or by a firm inside the denominated zone
because: Under the Italian labelling decree (DM 13 agosto 2012, art. 56, continuing DM 23 dicembre 2009 art. 3), 'imbottigliato all'origine' is reserved for bottling at the producer's own facility or at an association of producers (cantina sociale, produttori riuniti). Bottling by any firm inside the zone is a separate, broader claim, 'imbottigliato nella zona di produzione' or 'imbottigliato in [DOP/IGP]', which does not require the bottler to have made the wine. For the same reason the keyed option ('bottled in the zone where it was made') describes the zone term rather than the producer-bottling term, though it remains the best of the four options.
fix: Explanation: 'the filling was done at the premises of the producer who made the wine, or of its co-operative or producers' association, and the words are reserved for DOP and IGP wines. A firm that merely bottles inside the zone uses the separate phrase imbottigliato nella zona di produzione.' Option 1 could read: 'The wine was bottled by the producer who made it, or its co-operative, not tankered away and filled elsewhere'.
